narrative.overview:
A black OLED canvas, grayscale source controls and white focus follow the owner's supplied review design. The Xbox tile alone carries a forest tint and the supplied console photograph; quiet local date and time replace a visible page title.

This record describes the implemented v1.0.4 dashboard in `dashboard/index.html`, `dashboard/style.css`, `dashboard/app.js` and `dashboard/ports.js`. Browser evidence is `dashboard/artifacts/tv.png` and `mobile.png`. It records implementation, not confirmation of v1.0.4 installation or native behavior on the physical TV.
keyCharacteristics: Black canvas, neutral controls and one green Xbox tile.
Large source targets with a single white focus outline.
Local console imagery, date and time.
Configurable ports and explicit activated-control feedback.

rules.body: Only the focused control receives focus styling. Pointer entry moves focus; hover must not light a second control.
rules.name: The Single Focus Rule

rules.body: Keep “Switch to HDMI 2” beneath the Xbox name; named alternate ports retain the HDMI number underneath.
rules.name: The Action Line Rule

rules.body: Use surface tone, outlines and restrained focus scaling for hierarchy; keep controls shadow-free.
rules.name: The Flat Console Rule

dos: **Do** preserve grayscale controls, white focus and the green Xbox exception.
**Do** use the supplied local Xbox photograph and real local date and time.
**Do** preserve visible focus, busy labels and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep named and unused ports configurable without changing destinations.
donts: **Don't** imply live HDMI connection or signal status.
**Don't** use hover styling that creates a second highlighted control.
**Don't** confuse browser preview or package build with verified physical TV deployment.
**Don't** turn shortcut dots or transient notice colors into a broader accent palette.
